verdict.rationale: New Relic documents an AI assistant for exploring telemetry in plain language and for help with queries. Its official MCP server converts plain-English questions into NRQL and returns results, which meets the story's "real query" outcome. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the in-product AI returns generated NRQL or a rendered chart (only the MCP server's NL-to-NRQL conversion is stated), independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.
It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
If you're struggling to get a query to work, ask our AI assistant to help you.
